meta.title: Get your store ready for AI shopping
meta.description: Paste any store URL. ecentic reads your products, fixes what AI channels cannot use, and hands you a Google Merchant Center feed and a ChatGPT feed.

hero.title: Paste your store.
hero.accent: We’ll get it ready for Google, Gemini and ChatGPT.
hero.description: We read every product, up to 40, fix what we can from your store’s own pages, list what we can’t, and hand you both feeds.
hero.runTitle: Getting your store ready for Google, Gemini and ChatGPT

form.note: No sign-up. We read up to 40 products from your public pages.

errors.fallback: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
errors.invalid: That does not look like a store address we can read. Check it and try again.
errors.limited: You have started a lot of stores in a row. Give it a few minutes and try again.
errors.capacity: We have prepared as many stores as we can for today. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.unavailable: We could not start this run. Please try again in a moment.
errors.connect: That didn’t go through. Try again.
errors.connectLimited: Too many tries in a row. Give it a minute.
errors.address: We couldn’t read that store’s address.
errors.finish: We couldn’t finish this store. Try it again.

merchant.ownership: We only publish to Merchant Center accounts that own the store’s website.
